limitations: Emulated mobile layout only; no physical touch/FPS benchmark. Composition and movement still need further art polish. Not final release approval.

composition.observation: Distinct tree/mill, lighthouse/harbor and sloped caldera/forge; clear center routes. Shared flat hub layout and vegetation remain visually simple.

models.observation: Three hero meshes show distinct silhouettes and correct front direction; nine variants load. Existing 27 pets retained.

animation.observation: Windmill motion observed; smoother follower locomotion and limb poses work. Thundrake wings are fused with head; more species-specific movement remains.

feedback.observation: First equip increased +2 to +8 with toast and bounded burst. Hatch reveal and next action observed. Environmental effects are local and distance limited.

onboarding.observation: Mouse hatch/equip path completed. 320/390 portrait layouts corrected: dedicated egg guide row, stacked inventory/detail, readable scrollable badges.
